worlds.notice: Private notice: competitive benefit falls from 12 to 2; avoided regulatory burden remains 12.
worlds.decision_record: Direct decision record: under CA, the competitive payoff is 2 minus 6, so intended support is 0. No decision reversal occurs; the coalition withdraws support.
worlds.memo: Staff memorandum: the actual decision was to withdraw support. No memo reversal occurs.
worlds.public_note: Public announcement: the coalition withdraws its endorsement of the carbon-pricing proposal. No public reversal occurs.

candidates.implication: The public announcement differs from the actual decision exactly when one, but not both, of the memo and public transmission stages reverses. Therefore the predictive disagreement probability is 0.2(0.8)+0.8(0.2)=0.32.
candidates.derivation: Combines sequential transmission A→M→P with independent reversal probabilities of 0.2 at each transmission stage.
candidates.indicator: Code 0 when A=P (the announcement agrees with the actual decision); code 1 when A≠P (the announcement disagrees with the actual decision).

candidates.implication: Under the reserved-evidence predictive mixture, support is more likely when S=1 than when S=0: Pr(A=1|S=1)=0.56 and Pr(A=1|S=0)=0.44.
candidates.derivation: Under SA, intended support equals S; under CA, it equals 1−S. Mixing these rules with posterior weights 0.6 and 0.4, then applying the independent 0.2 decision reversal, yields the stated probabilities.
candidates.indicator: Code 0 for (S,A)=(0,0); code 1 for (0,1); code 2 for (1,0); code 3 for (1,1). M and P do not affect the category.
